r13_contract.comparisonModel: Under section 3 of the Act on the Ice Classes of Ships and Icebreaker Assistance (1121/2005), ships are assigned to ice classes IA Super, IA, IB, IC, II, or III.

test_cases.rationale: Ice class IA Super is one of the six source-permitted classes.
Ice class IA is one of the six source-permitted classes.
Ice class IB is one of the six source-permitted classes.
Ice class IC is one of the six source-permitted classes.
Ice class II is one of the six source-permitted classes.
Ice class III is one of the six source-permitted classes.
An unlisted ice-class value is not permitted.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
